configurations.R: accepted frozen14 cached reference; attribution absent
configurations.D: identical recovered attribution source with observer disabled; cost_attribution null or enabled=false
configurations.E: same recovered attribution source with private observer enabled; aggregate record emitted only after PC_PROP_END

timing.outer: Linux per-process CPU and monotonic perf_counter_ns command-to-end-marker intervals; startup, parsing, DUMP, serialization and output comparison excluded
timing.inner: Rust Instant monotonic wall; fixed 2-phase x 15-scope accumulators and bounded 16-depth RAII nesting; no observer allocations or serialization inside scopes; per-scope child elapsed removed exactly once

initialization: natural_jacobian inclusive, owning first/base core and every remaining FD core entry
other setup/unassigned includes phase change and marker/copy effects
proposal: selected_jacobian inclusive with first/base and remaining FD core children
refinement inclusive owning any refinement SVD/damping/active-KKT child
acceptance inclusive owning any other core

timing.accounting: For each phase/scope inclusive minus sum of recorded direct child edge durations equals exclusive. Sum exclusive scope durations is charged once against outer phase wall interval; unassigned = outer wall - sum exclusive, negative is a recording defect. Each incoming edge sum must not exceed child inclusive. Aggregate each batch before medians/shares. Scopes of same name can have different parents; complete direct-child matrix is retained. Combined sums init+proposal without between-command wait.

source_boundaries.natural_selected_jacobian: evaluate_core_with_jacobian entry through return; selected_probe selects assembly kind, phase is benchmark command
source_boundaries.core: actual core() entry through return, nearest active Jacobian and its core ordinal distinguishes base/FD
source_boundaries.svd: jacobi_factor entire call; actual entered sweep loop increments count
source_boundaries.acceptance: transition_after_model entire call, any timed child excluded from exclusive

batch_record: Each E batch stores hierarchy times/counts, outer CPU/wall totals, remainders and reconciliation. R/D retain outer CPU/wall and complete outcomes only.

cohort.gating: Do not execute until independent readiness approval.

measurement_quality.screen: Median within-triplet ratios; also retain ratio of absolute cost medians and conservatively flag disagreement. Over-threshold attribution is inconclusive for precise baseline shares; no redesign/repetition.

observer_effects: Timer acquisition/accumulator costs within parents become parent-exclusive; top-level observer entry/exit, uninstrumented setup, command/marker and final-output-copy effects remain unassigned. No invented subtraction or rescaling. Components are wall only.

Python synthetic analyzer controls, exact cohort driver, independent result reconciliation, source recovery verification
